title: Expiry of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Expiry.** A Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers credit that is still active at the end of its expiry date expires on the following calendar day. Its entire remaining value is written off in one write-off entry.

**Write-off condition.** An expiry write-off is booked only on a credit whose status is expired, as the system records it for that credit.

**Credits that never expire.** A depleted, refunded or voided credit never expires. An issued voucher awaiting acceptance is voided rather than expired.

**Travel already ticketed.** Travel already ticketed with the credit's value is unaffected by the credit's later expiry.

**After expiry.** After expiry the only way back to the value is reinstatement under the reinstatement rule. There is no automatic grace period.

The expiry date itself follows from each instrument's validity months, which are 12 calendar months on every instrument.

## Status and expiry at a glance

| Status at the end of the expiry date | What happens the next calendar day |
|---|---|
| active | The credit expires and its entire remaining value is written off in one write-off entry |
| depleted | Nothing; a depleted credit never expires |
| refunded | Nothing; a refunded credit never expires |
| voided | Nothing; a voided credit never expires |
| issued, awaiting acceptance | Not expired; such a voucher is voided rather than expired |

## Hypothetical case

An active credit with an expiry date of 30 April and a remaining value of 86.40 US dollars expires on 1 May, and 86.40 is written off in one write-off entry. A ticket bought with this credit on 12 April for travel in June is unaffected.
